src/Services/GenericCsvImporter.php.description: Primary CSV importer with auto-format detection (content_tracker vs tiktok_export). Processes row-by-row with 3+ DB queries per row. Key optimization target for batch processing.

src/Services/TikTokCsvImporter.php.description: Legacy TikTok-specific CSV importer. Simpler than GenericCsvImporter. Uses same row-by-row pattern. Should share optimizations with GenericCsvImporter.

scripts/000_create_database_schema.sql.description: Database schema with posts (18+ columns), metrics_history (time-series), hashtag_performance, post_hashtags (junction), import_history tables. All use InnoDB with proper indexes.
